postTransformationGuidelines: After updating EF Core to 8.0.33, run 'dotnet ef database update' to apply any pending migrations. The existing migrations have a ProductVersion annotation of 3.0.0 which will be updated automatically by EF Core tools.
Verify the application starts and all endpoints work after the upgrade. The Program.cs uses the minimal hosting model (WebApplicationBuilder) which is fully supported on .NET 8.

The connection string was updated with Encrypt=False to preserve the old behavior with the new EF Core 8 / SqlClient default that encrypts connections by default. If encryption with certificate validation is desired in production, replace Encrypt=False with TrustServerCertificate=True or configure the server with a certificate the host trusts.
